He handles each case hands-on from intake through settlement and trial preparation, and he has been recognized as a Super Lawyers Rising Star in Southern California for three consecutive years. He has represented thousands of Californians in cases ranging from minor injuries to catastrophic personal injury, wrongful death, car and motorcycle accidents, product liability, landlord–tenant matters, and more. He also contributes legal blog content on topics including auto accidents, bike accidents, dog bites, drunk driving, and wildfire-related damage.
